title: Prior Session Levels
summary: How often the session trades back to the prior session's high (or low), conditioned on where it opened inside the prior range. The open-position filter is the classic continuation/mean-reversion cut; every other registry predicate composes on top.

params.name: minOpenPos
params.doc: Only sessions that opened at least this far up the prior range (0 = prior low, 1 = prior high).

params.name: maxOpenPos
params.doc: Only sessions that opened at most this far up the prior range.

deltas: generalizes beyond fixed 'open in upper/lower half' cuts: the open position is a continuous filter
swap the outcome for touchPrevLow / breakHoldPrevHigh to get the full family from the same registry
